title: Kerberoasting behavior
detection_hypothesis: Review service-ticket activity against account and service baseline
positive_evidence: Compare DC ticket records with an independently recorded authorized test and established application usage.
negative_control: Routine service authentication and scheduled jobs.
limitations: A ticket request alone does not establish password recovery or compromise.

title: AS-REP roasting behavior
detection_hypothesis: Review unusual authentication requests and preauthentication status
positive_evidence: Review successful authentication records with the account policy snapshot and independently documented lab activity.
negative_control: Approved accounts with legacy authentication exceptions.
limitations: Failed preauthentication alone does not establish this technique; ticket acquisition does not establish password recovery.

title: Golden ticket suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Correlate identity sensor alerts and ticket history; missing history alone is insufficient
positive_evidence: Correlate identity alerts with historical DC and endpoint records and the independent incident or lab record.
negative_control: Legitimate long-running sessions and incomplete retention.
limitations: Missing ticket history is not evidence of forgery.

title: Silver ticket suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review service-side logons and available KDC evidence; account for cached tickets
positive_evidence: Review service-side authentication evidence alongside identity alerts and retained DC records for the scoped session.
negative_control: Ordinary service sessions and cached credentials.
limitations: Missing DC events alone cannot establish ticket forgery.

title: Pass-the-ticket suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review unexpected account and device combinations with EDR context
positive_evidence: Corroborate the scoped identity alert with session records and independently documented activity.
negative_control: Approved service or administrator sessions.
limitations: Authentication records alone cannot establish ticket theft or reuse.

title: Kerberos preauthentication failures
detection_hypothesis: Review failures by account and approved client baseline
positive_evidence: Group DC failure records by scoped account and time; compare reported client and failure reason with support records.
negative_control: Expired cached credentials or user password errors.
limitations: Failures alone do not establish malicious intent or successful authentication.

title: TGT request anomalies
detection_hypothesis: Compare account and source against historical authentication patterns
positive_evidence: Compare observed TGT request identity, client and time with approved sign-in history and device inventory.
negative_control: New workstation or scheduled service startup.
limitations: A new client is not evidence of account compromise; schema varies by DC update.

title: Service ticket failure anomalies
detection_hypothesis: Review result codes and expected service activity
positive_evidence: Review service-ticket failure status and service identity alongside outage or maintenance records.
negative_control: Service rename, unavailable service or configuration error.
limitations: A failed request does not establish successful service access.

title: Ticket renewal anomalies
detection_hypothesis: Compare renewal activity with account usage policy
positive_evidence: Compare renewal timestamps and identity with documented service session lifetimes.
negative_control: Long-running approved applications and ordinary renewals.
limitations: Renewal records do not establish ticket theft.

title: Legacy ticket encryption visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review negotiated encryption with migration inventory
positive_evidence: Compare recorded ticket encryption type with service inventory and approved migration exceptions.
negative_control: Approved legacy application compatibility.
limitations: Ticket encryption is not necessarily the session-key encryption; verify event version.

title: TGT encryption policy visibility
detection_hypothesis: Check ticket encryption fields against approved policy
positive_evidence: Review TGT encryption fields from the actual event version against the effective authentication baseline.
negative_control: Documented compatibility exceptions during migration.
limitations: Advertised or supported types do not establish which encryption was negotiated.

title: Service account ticket volume
detection_hypothesis: Review service usage changes with owner context
positive_evidence: Compare scoped service account ticket totals to its own business-hour and batch-job history.
negative_control: Approved batch workload or deployment spike.
limitations: Volume alone is not proof of malicious activity; incomplete DC collection biases counts.

title: Privileged account Kerberos usage
detection_hypothesis: Compare privileged identities with approved administration inventory
positive_evidence: Reconcile privileged account authentication records with approved admin workstations and change windows.
negative_control: Documented emergency maintenance or delegated administration.
limitations: Privilege membership and a ticket event do not prove privileged action.

title: Dormant identity Kerberos activity
detection_hypothesis: Correlate sign-in activity with identity lifecycle records
positive_evidence: Join the authentication record to the identity owner, lifecycle status and approved access record.
negative_control: Reactivated employee, maintenance or break-glass account.
limitations: Dormancy alone does not establish unauthorized use.

title: Unexpected client authentication
detection_hypothesis: Compare source identity with registered devices
positive_evidence: Reconcile client address at event time with device inventory, DHCP and approved remote access.
negative_control: DHCP reassignment or approved VPN client.
limitations: IP attribution can be ambiguous behind shared gateways.

title: Service principal change
detection_hypothesis: Review directory change audit against approved change tickets
positive_evidence: Compare the audited SPN attribute change and object identity with before/after directory snapshots and owner approval.
negative_control: Approved service migration or rename.
limitations: An object-change record alone does not establish subsequent ticket activity.

title: Preauthentication setting change
detection_hypothesis: Review account configuration changes with approval evidence
positive_evidence: Compare relevant account policy before and after the reported change with the documented exception and owner.
negative_control: Approved legacy authentication exception.
limitations: A general user change event does not identify the precise setting without attributes or snapshots.

title: Kerberos delegation setting change
detection_hypothesis: Review delegation-related configuration changes against baseline
positive_evidence: Compare audited service configuration attribute changes with approved delegation inventory.
negative_control: Application onboarding or service migration.
limitations: The event establishes a configuration observation, not actual delegated authentication.

title: Kerberos event ingestion completeness
detection_hypothesis: Compare collector records with authoritative DC event export
positive_evidence: Compare equivalent bounded DC exports and collector records by source, record identifier and time after ingestion delay.
negative_control: Collector maintenance or expected forwarding filters.
limitations: Incomplete retention prevents a reliable missing-event conclusion; event IDs alone do not identify unique records.

title: Kerberos policy baseline
detection_hypothesis: Review effective ticket and encryption policies with administrator-provided snapshot
positive_evidence: Review effective domain Kerberos policy and approved compatibility exceptions with the domain owner.
negative_control: Documented compatibility setting with expiry and owner.
limitations: A policy snapshot is not a runtime authentication or detection test.

title: NTLM successful validation
detection_hypothesis: Review approved legacy authentication baseline
positive_evidence: Review successful credential validation status on the authoritative source and reconcile the account with approved legacy inventory.
negative_control: Routine legacy application authentication.
limitations: Credential validation is not proof of a specific destination session.

title: NTLM failed validation
detection_hypothesis: Review failure patterns with helpdesk context
positive_evidence: Review failure status, reported workstation and account against support tickets and time window.
negative_control: Expired service password or user typing error.
limitations: Failures alone do not establish malicious attempts or a subsequent success.

title: NTLM network logon
detection_hypothesis: Review authentication package and source inventory
positive_evidence: Confirm the authentication package and logon type in destination-host records; compare with approved client inventory.
negative_control: Routine file-share or service access.
limitations: A network logon does not establish which business operation occurred.

title: Pass-the-hash suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Correlate endpoint and DC evidence with identity sensor findings; not proof of hash use
positive_evidence: Correlate endpoint and identity alerts with scoped authentication records and independent incident evidence.
negative_control: Approved legacy authentication and remote administration.
limitations: NTLM event presence cannot distinguish password-based logon from credential-material misuse.

title: NTLM password spray suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review account-distributed failures against known service disruptions
positive_evidence: Review aggregate failed authentication records, scoped identity set, source health and service ownership.
negative_control: Expired service credentials, misconfigured clients and legitimate user failures.
limitations: Authentication failures do not identify the attempted secret or prove a spraying campaign.

title: NTLM privileged account use
detection_hypothesis: Review privileged authentication against tier policy
positive_evidence: Correlate privileged identity inventory with approved administration records and destination logon evidence.
negative_control: Authorized legacy administration exception.
limitations: Validation events alone cannot establish privilege use at a destination.

title: NTLM service account use
detection_hypothesis: Compare observed service identities with registered owners
positive_evidence: Reconcile service account usage with documented application ownership and expected host relationships.
negative_control: Scheduled batch job or application restart.
limitations: Shared service identity may limit attribution to a specific application.

title: NTLM workstation mismatch
detection_hypothesis: Compare source identity and asset records with DHCP context
positive_evidence: Resolve reported workstation and source-address context against time-valid inventory.
negative_control: Renamed workstation, DHCP change or remote access gateway.
limitations: Reported workstation fields are not independent device identity proof.

title: NTLM audit policy review
detection_hypothesis: Review effective NTLM audit settings and coverage
positive_evidence: Review effective NTLM auditing settings and a source-by-source collection inventory against the approved baseline.
negative_control: Documented temporary policy exception.
limitations: Policy snapshots do not prove actual event delivery; check separate telemetry evidence.

title: NTLM restriction policy review
detection_hypothesis: Review approved legacy exceptions and effective restriction settings
positive_evidence: Compare effective NTLM restriction policies with the approved legacy-service register and exception owner.
negative_control: Documented staged migration or temporary compatibility exception.
limitations: Configured policy does not establish enforcement on every host.

title: NTLM relay suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review identity sensor findings with server authentication context; events alone do not establish relay
positive_evidence: Review the existing identity-sensor finding and corroborating server authentication evidence with the incident timeline.
negative_control: Routine integrated authentication or approved proxy architecture.
limitations: Authentication records cannot independently establish relay; require qualified corroboration.

title: NTLM channel visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review collector health and source availability for NTLM operational events
positive_evidence: Compare NTLM operational channel availability and collector configuration across in-scope hosts.
negative_control: Planned collector maintenance or approved channel filtering.
limitations: Configured collection does not prove end-to-end delivery.

title: LDAP unsigned bind audit
detection_hypothesis: Review unsigned bind audit evidence and known legacy clients
positive_evidence: Relevant DC Directory Service records identifying a client where the required diagnostic logging is enabled; verify client ownership and bind policy.
negative_control: Approved signed or protected LDAP client sessions with an independently verified configuration.
limitations: Diagnostic logging is not necessarily enabled and event absence cannot establish secure binds.

title: LDAP signing posture
detection_hypothesis: Review effective DC LDAP signing policy
positive_evidence: Review effective LDAP signing configuration from approved domain-controller inventory and change records.
negative_control: Approved time-limited compatibility exception.
limitations: A snapshot does not prove all client connections are compliant.

title: LDAP channel binding posture
detection_hypothesis: Review effective channel binding policy and compatibility exceptions
positive_evidence: Review effective channel-binding policy and documented client compatibility exceptions.
negative_control: Approved temporary exception during migration.
limitations: Configuration is not evidence of runtime enforcement.

title: LDAP channel binding warning
detection_hypothesis: Review channel binding audit diagnostics with client inventory
positive_evidence: Review Directory Service channel diagnostics and effective channel-binding policy; reconcile affected client with owner.
negative_control: Approved compatibility remediation in progress.
limitations: 3039 is policy and diagnostic dependent; absence is not assurance of successful enforcement.

title: LDAP account discovery suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review directory query activity with diagnostic logging and approved administration baselines
positive_evidence: Review directory diagnostic records with approved client inventory and the documented purpose of directory activity.
negative_control: Identity inventory, address book synchronization and administration.
limitations: Event 1644 is selective diagnostic logging, not comprehensive directory query coverage.

title: LDAP group discovery suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review group query activity with legitimate application baselines
positive_evidence: Compare directory diagnostic records about group lookup with known inventory jobs and client ownership.
negative_control: Access reviews, authorization lookups and IAM synchronization.
limitations: A lookup alone is not hostile reconnaissance; absence may reflect diagnostic settings.

title: LDAP search performance audit
detection_hypothesis: Review expensive search diagnostics with application owners
positive_evidence: Review directory search diagnostics with application owners and approved workload context.
negative_control: Legitimate reporting or inventory application.
limitations: Diagnostic selection and thresholds affect visibility; expensive searches do not establish hostile activity.

title: LDAP sensitive object access
detection_hypothesis: Review audited object access with directory ownership records
positive_evidence: Review audited object identity, access context and authorized role against the sensitive-object inventory.
negative_control: Routine directory administration or access review.
limitations: Access auditing depends on audit policy and applicable SACL; record alone does not establish harmful use.

title: LDAP directory change visibility
detection_hypothesis: Confirm object modification records reach collection pipeline
positive_evidence: Compare a bounded authoritative object-change export with collector records and change ticket.
negative_control: Approved directory maintenance.
limitations: A forwarded event does not establish complete directory-change coverage.

title: LDAP diagnostic coverage
detection_hypothesis: Review DC diagnostic level and collector availability without changing settings
positive_evidence: Compare effective LDAP diagnostic configuration, channels and collector health against approved monitoring requirements.
negative_control: Approved diagnostic reduction for resource management.
limitations: Configuration review cannot prove delivery or enforcement.

title: Certificate request visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review request identity, template and CA records
positive_evidence: Reconcile CA request records with request identity, issuance workflow and approved template inventory.
negative_control: Ordinary certificate enrollment or renewal.
limitations: A request event does not establish issuance or subsequent certificate use.

title: Certificate issuance visibility
detection_hypothesis: Correlate issuance with approved enrollment inventory
positive_evidence: CA-issued certificate event correlated to request ID, approved template and certificate inventory; compare with the authorized enrollment record.
negative_control: Routine approved certificate renewal and auto-enrollment.
limitations: Certificate issuance alone does not prove certificate misuse or authentication.

title: Certificate request denial
detection_hypothesis: Review denied requests with enrollment support context
positive_evidence: Review denied-request record and disposition against enrollment policy and support records.
negative_control: Expired approval or ordinary enrollment failure.
limitations: Denial of one request does not prove all related requests were denied.

title: Certificate revocation activity
detection_hypothesis: Review revocations against approved lifecycle actions
positive_evidence: Reconcile revocation record with certificate inventory and lifecycle ticket.
negative_control: Routine decommissioning or approved replacement.
limitations: Revocation event does not establish client-side revocation enforcement.

title: CA permission change
detection_hypothesis: Review CA security changes with change approvals
positive_evidence: Compare CA security changes with before/after access review and approved change ticket.
negative_control: Authorized PKI role rotation.
limitations: Event presence does not establish effective permissions after inheritance or subsequent changes.

title: CA configuration change
detection_hypothesis: Review CA configuration events with PKI administrator baseline
positive_evidence: Compare CA configuration snapshot and audited change context to the approved maintenance record.
negative_control: CA upgrade or approved property change.
limitations: 4890 and 4891 describe different configuration changes; inspect actual record rather than treating them as interchangeable.

title: Certificate manager settings change
detection_hypothesis: Review certificate manager configuration with approval records
positive_evidence: Compare certificate manager settings before and after the event with approved role policy.
negative_control: Planned PKI responsibility reassignment.
limitations: Settings-change telemetry does not establish issuance or use of certificates.

title: Certificate template load visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review template loading against CA inventory
positive_evidence: Reconcile CA template-load record with approved CA template inventory.
negative_control: Normal service startup or template refresh.
limitations: A loaded template does not establish its effective permissions or issuance.

title: Certificate template update visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review template changes against change records
positive_evidence: Compare template versions and approved change records with CA template-update observation.
negative_control: Approved certificate policy rollout.
limitations: CA-side update observation does not establish complete directory-side change history.

title: Certificate template permissions update
detection_hypothesis: Review template security change against approval and owner records
positive_evidence: Review template security change evidence alongside authoritative security descriptor and owner approval.
negative_control: Approved delegation change.
limitations: Effective permissions require separate review; an event alone does not establish misuse.

title: Enrollment permission review
detection_hypothesis: Review authorized template enrollment principals with PKI owners
positive_evidence: Review authorized certificate template enrollment ACL inventory and owner-approved enrollment groups.
negative_control: Documented enrollment role granted for a valid business requirement.
limitations: Effective rights depend on nested membership and CA/template settings.

title: Template identity binding review
detection_hypothesis: Review certificate identity binding policy and template risk assessment
positive_evidence: Review template identity-binding policy, approved certificate use and change history.
negative_control: An approved purpose-specific identity enrollment workflow.
limitations: Template settings alone do not establish credential compromise.

title: Template purpose review
detection_hypothesis: Review authentication-capable template purposes with business requirements
positive_evidence: Compare template application purposes with approved certificate use cases and documented owners.
negative_control: Authorized application-specific authentication template.
limitations: Purpose configuration alone does not establish exploitability or issuance.

title: Template approval review
detection_hypothesis: Review manager approval and issuance policy against requirements
positive_evidence: Review effective approval requirements and documented exceptions for the scoped templates.
negative_control: Approved unattended enrollment workflow.
limitations: Approval settings do not prove actual enforcement for every request.

title: Enrollment agent governance
detection_hypothesis: Review enrollment agent permissions and restrictions with PKI owners
positive_evidence: Reconcile authorized enrollment-agent roles and restrictions with documented certificate workflows.
negative_control: Approved enrollment service performing its assigned role.
limitations: Inventory alone does not prove issuance controls are effective.

title: CA administrator governance
detection_hypothesis: Review administrative role separation and access reviews
positive_evidence: Compare CA administrator and certificate manager role inventory with separation-of-duties requirements.
negative_control: Approved temporary break-glass assignment.
limitations: Role membership does not prove use or misuse of that role.

title: CA endpoint protection review
detection_hypothesis: Review enrollment endpoint authentication protections and transport policy
positive_evidence: Review approved enrollment endpoint inventory and effective transport/authentication policy records.
negative_control: Documented legacy endpoint migration exception.
limitations: A configuration snapshot is not proof of runtime enforcement or exploitability.

title: Certificate mapping policy review
detection_hypothesis: Review effective certificate mapping and strong binding posture
positive_evidence: Review effective certificate mapping policy and documented compatibility exceptions against vendor guidance.
negative_control: Approved certificate migration in progress.
limitations: Effective policy must be verified per relevant DC; configuration alone does not establish misuse.

title: Unusual certificate authentication
detection_hypothesis: Review certificate-backed authentication with CA and identity sensor evidence
positive_evidence: Review certificate-related authentication evidence alongside CA issuance history, owner and approved certificate lifecycle.
negative_control: Smart-card logon, normal renewal and certificate-based service authentication.
limitations: Unusual authentication does not establish certificate theft or forgery.

title: PKI audit coverage
detection_hypothesis: Review CA audit policy and collection completeness with known source inventory
positive_evidence: Reconcile enabled CA audit categories and source inventory against approved collection requirements.
negative_control: Scheduled collector outage or documented filtering.
limitations: Audit settings do not independently prove event completeness.

title: Unconstrained delegation inventory
detection_hypothesis: Review approved delegation inventory against tier boundaries
positive_evidence: Review approved account inventory and documented delegation relationships with service owners.
negative_control: Legacy service with a reviewed, time-limited exception.
limitations: Configuration posture alone does not establish delegation misuse.

title: Constrained delegation inventory
detection_hypothesis: Review permitted service relationships against application ownership
positive_evidence: Compare service relationship inventory with approved application dependency records and owners.
negative_control: Approved service-to-service integration.
limitations: Configured relationship is not proof of actual use or exploitation.

title: Resource-based delegation inventory
detection_hypothesis: Review authorized delegation principals and resource ownership
positive_evidence: Review the authorized directory snapshot against approved service relationships and ownership.
negative_control: Documented service provisioning and approved delegation.
limitations: Effective relationships require identity and permission context.

title: Delegation change on computer object
detection_hypothesis: Review computer object changes with delegation baseline
positive_evidence: Scoped directory change record and before/after directory snapshot; compare changed property and object identity against approved change record.
negative_control: Authorized delegation maintenance on a disposable lab object.
limitations: Directory change logging depends on SACL and audit policy; change alone is not compromise.

title: Delegation change on service identity
detection_hypothesis: Review service identity changes with change tickets
positive_evidence: Compare service identity changes with before/after approved service configuration and change ticket.
negative_control: Application deployment or service migration.
limitations: Object modification alone does not establish a delegated session.

title: Delegation change on privileged identity
detection_hypothesis: Review changes affecting privileged identity controls
positive_evidence: Compare protected identity settings and ownership before/after the change with privileged-access approval.
negative_control: Approved privileged account maintenance.
limitations: Change event does not establish subsequent privilege use.

title: Sensitive account delegation protection
detection_hypothesis: Review protected identity settings against tier requirements
positive_evidence: Review documented sensitive identities and effective delegation protection settings against approved tier policy.
negative_control: Documented temporary application compatibility exception.
limitations: Configuration alone does not establish runtime enforcement.

title: Delegation service relationship drift
detection_hypothesis: Compare snapshots of approved service relationships
positive_evidence: Compare dated service relationship inventories and reconcile changes with owner-approved dependency updates.
negative_control: Approved migration or service retirement.
limitations: Snapshots may omit intermediate changes; drift is not evidence of exploitation.

title: Delegation principal lifecycle
detection_hypothesis: Review identity deletion and delegation inventory consistency
positive_evidence: Reconcile account removal events and remaining approved service relationships using stable object identities.
negative_control: Normal decommissioning or service replacement.
limitations: Deletion records alone do not prove all related permissions were removed.

title: Delegated authentication anomalies
detection_hypothesis: Review service authentication context with identity sensor evidence
positive_evidence: Review existing identity-sensor alert and scoped service authentication records against known service relationships.
negative_control: Routine approved delegated service operation.
limitations: Service-ticket telemetry alone cannot establish abusive delegation.

title: Delegation audit scope
detection_hypothesis: Review SACL and collection coverage for critical objects
positive_evidence: Review applicable SACLs, audit policy and collector source inventory for designated critical objects.
negative_control: Approved audit scope exception or maintenance.
limitations: Configuration coverage is not event delivery or detection coverage.

title: Delegation approval reconciliation
detection_hypothesis: Review current delegation inventory against approved change records
positive_evidence: Reconcile effective service relationship inventory with approved owner, ticket and review date.
negative_control: Approved recently changed relationship awaiting inventory refresh.
limitations: A missing ticket may indicate documentation lag; not proof of abuse.

title: Domain root ACL drift
detection_hypothesis: Review ACL changes with authoritative baseline
positive_evidence: Domain root security descriptor snapshots from approved read-only exports; identify a material permission difference and reconcile with change records.
negative_control: Approved permission maintenance with documented baseline and owner.
limitations: A changed descriptor is not proof that the permission was used.

title: Privileged group ACL drift
detection_hypothesis: Review group ACL changes against approved administrators
positive_evidence: Compare privileged group security descriptors before and after the scoped directory change against approved role assignments.
negative_control: Authorized delegated administration change.
limitations: General object change does not prove effective permission or group membership changed.

title: OU ACL drift
detection_hypothesis: Review organizational unit access changes with owner context
positive_evidence: Review scoped OU permission snapshots and inheritance alongside change approval.
negative_control: Approved organizational restructuring.
limitations: Inherited effects require separate evaluation; event alone does not prove access.

title: Service account ACL drift
detection_hypothesis: Review service identity ACL changes against ownership policy
positive_evidence: Compare service account object permissions with ownership and application support role inventory.
negative_control: Approved service owner transition.
limitations: Configuration change does not prove that the permission was exercised.

title: Computer object ACL drift
detection_hypothesis: Review computer object permission changes with owner context
positive_evidence: Compare computer-object permissions and inheritance with approved device management roles.
negative_control: Approved device enrollment or administrative transfer.
limitations: Object ACL change does not establish host-level compromise.

title: AdminSDHolder ACL review
detection_hypothesis: Review protected-object security descriptor baseline
positive_evidence: Compare AdminSDHolder ACL snapshots and approved privileged-role design with directory change records.
negative_control: Approved privileged administration model.
limitations: A snapshot alone cannot show runtime access or prove abuse.

title: Directory owner change
detection_hypothesis: Review available security descriptor changes and approved ownership records
positive_evidence: Compare ownership records and security descriptor snapshots with approved ownership transfer; confirm event provider and object type.
negative_control: Approved ownership recovery or administrative change.
limitations: 4670 may concern non-directory objects; require actual object context and appropriate source.

title: Inherited permission review
detection_hypothesis: Review effective permissions and inheritance with directory administrators
positive_evidence: Review effective inherited permissions on scoped objects against parent policy and authorized role inventory.
negative_control: Approved OU-level delegation.
limitations: Descriptor snapshot is not evidence of effective access for every identity without group context.

title: Replication permission review
detection_hypothesis: Review authorized replication-related permissions against approved services
positive_evidence: Review effective directory replication permissions against the authorized replication and synchronization inventory.
negative_control: Approved domain controllers and directory synchronization accounts.
limitations: Assigned rights do not prove that replication activity occurred.

title: Password reset delegation review
detection_hypothesis: Review delegated account management roles against support requirements
positive_evidence: Review delegated account-support roles and approved reset permissions against organizational scope.
negative_control: Approved help desk duties.
limitations: Permission existence is not evidence that any password was reset.

title: Group management delegation review
detection_hypothesis: Review authorized group management roles and owners
positive_evidence: Compare group-management delegation and owner approvals with actual group scope and effective roles.
negative_control: Approved group-owner delegation.
limitations: Rights inventory alone does not show that membership was changed.

title: GPO object ACL review
detection_hypothesis: Review policy object permissions against change governance
positive_evidence: Review policy-object and associated file-side permissions against approved policy administration roles.
negative_control: Approved policy management delegation.
limitations: Directory-side ACL alone is insufficient to evaluate the complete policy object.

title: Certificate template ACL review
detection_hypothesis: Review template security descriptors with PKI administrators
positive_evidence: Compare certificate-template effective access and inheritance with approved PKI ownership and enrollment policy.
negative_control: Authorized enrollment or template maintenance.
limitations: Template ACL posture is not proof of certificate issuance or misuse.

title: Unexpected directory access
detection_hypothesis: Review audited access in context of object sensitivity and authorized actors
positive_evidence: Review access event object identity and approved actor role alongside effective audit coverage.
negative_control: Routine administrative read or inventory job.
limitations: Audit record alone does not establish sensitive data disclosure or malicious intent.

title: Directory SACL coverage
detection_hypothesis: Review audit coverage for protected objects and sensitive changes
positive_evidence: Compare protected-object SACL configuration and collection sources against defined audit requirements.
negative_control: Approved targeted auditing to reduce noise.
limitations: A SACL snapshot cannot establish delivery, completeness or alert behavior.

title: DCSync suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review replication-related identity sensor alerts and audited directory access with approved replication inventory
positive_evidence: Review identity sensor findings with directory access auditing, known replication roles and approved synchronization records.
negative_control: Authorized domain replication and directory synchronization services.
limitations: A generic directory-access event is insufficient to demonstrate credential extraction.

title: Directory database access suspicion
detection_hypothesis: Review EDR findings and audited sensitive file access with backup context
positive_evidence: Review authorized endpoint file-access evidence alongside backup inventory, process ownership and documented operations.
negative_control: Domain controller backup, restoration or approved maintenance.
limitations: File-access events depend on audit policy and do not establish credential extraction.

title: Domain controller computer creation
detection_hypothesis: Review new computer objects against approved DC lifecycle
positive_evidence: Reconcile computer creation record with approved DC deployment inventory and subsequent role verification.
negative_control: Approved server provisioning.
limitations: 4741 is a computer-account creation event, not proof the system became a DC.

title: Domain controller computer changes
detection_hypothesis: Review computer account changes against approved maintenance
positive_evidence: Compare computer account changes and DC maintenance record with authoritative role inventory.
negative_control: Approved DC maintenance or machine account update.
limitations: 4742 alone does not establish a change in DC role or replication behavior.

title: Replication destination review
detection_hypothesis: Review authorized replication topology and endpoint ownership
positive_evidence: Compare authorized replication topology and destination ownership with dated infrastructure inventory.
negative_control: Approved DC addition or site migration.
limitations: Topology review is not proof of actual replication traffic or misuse.

title: Replica source naming context established
detection_hypothesis: Review the audited replica source naming-context change against approved topology records
positive_evidence: Reconcile replica source naming-context establishment with approved topology and maintenance records.
negative_control: Normal DC promotion or topology convergence.
limitations: 4928 refers to a replica source naming context, not independently to a connection-object creation or malicious replication.

title: Replica source naming context removed
detection_hypothesis: Review the audited replica source naming-context change against approved topology records
positive_evidence: Reconcile replica source naming-context removal with approved topology and decommissioning records.
negative_control: Normal topology adjustment or DC removal.
limitations: 4929 refers to a replica source naming context, not independently to a connection-object removal.

title: Directory backup governance
detection_hypothesis: Review approved backup identities and access boundaries
positive_evidence: Review backup identity inventory and approved access scope against documented recovery requirements.
negative_control: Approved directory backup or restore service.
limitations: Role assignment alone does not establish backup contents or use.

title: DC privileged session activity
detection_hypothesis: Review privileged sessions against dedicated admin workflows
positive_evidence: Review DC destination logon and special-privilege records in the same host/session context against approved admin records.
negative_control: Approved maintenance or service logon.
limitations: Special privileges assigned at logon do not prove they were exercised.

title: DC audit source completeness
detection_hypothesis: Review DC inventory, sensor health and log coverage
positive_evidence: Compare the approved domain-controller inventory with each expected source heartbeat and retention record.
negative_control: Documented maintenance outage and approved collector replacement.
limitations: Incomplete coverage makes negative detection claims inconclusive.

title: GPO object creation
detection_hypothesis: Review newly created policy objects and approval records
positive_evidence: Correlate the policy object creation record with its owner, scope and approved change ticket.
negative_control: Creation of an approved new policy.
limitations: Object creation alone establishes neither policy application nor malicious modification.

title: GPO object modification
detection_hypothesis: Review policy metadata change and approved change request
positive_evidence: Review before/after policy snapshots and the recorded change authorization for the same object.
negative_control: Routine policy rollout or approved security hardening.
limitations: A directory update alone does not prove harmful policy effects.

title: GPO object deletion
detection_hypothesis: Review deleted policy objects and change records
positive_evidence: Review deleted policy identity, prior linked scope, approval record and restoration requirements.
negative_control: Planned retirement of a superseded policy.
limitations: Deletion alone does not establish malicious activity or resulting host configuration.

title: GPO link changes
detection_hypothesis: Review policy link changes and authorized scope
positive_evidence: Compare approved link scope and before/after policy relationships with the corresponding change ticket.
negative_control: OU reorganization and planned policy rollout.
limitations: Link change is a related policy action, not proof of harmful execution.

title: GPO permissions review
detection_hypothesis: Review policy ACL and designated owners
positive_evidence: Compare policy-object and associated file permissions against approved policy editors and owners.
negative_control: Approved policy delegation.
limitations: Configuration review does not establish actual policy modification.

title: SYSVOL write audit
detection_hypothesis: Review audited policy share access with file and change records
positive_evidence: Review audited SYSVOL share access and independent file-change records against approved policy changes.
negative_control: Normal policy deployment or administrative maintenance.
limitations: 5145 describes an access check; write-related access does not prove a completed file write.

title: GPO version consistency
detection_hypothesis: Compare approved policy versions across authorized snapshots
positive_evidence: Review authorized policy backups and directory/SYSVOL version evidence with the change owner.
negative_control: Expected propagation delay during an approved policy rollout.
limitations: Version mismatch alone cannot establish an attack.

title: Security policy drift
detection_hypothesis: Review effective security baseline against approved policy
positive_evidence: Compare effective security policy snapshot with approved baseline, scope and exception record.
negative_control: Approved temporary compatibility policy.
limitations: Drift alone does not prove compromise or policy application across all hosts.

title: GPO script governance
detection_hypothesis: Review centrally managed script inventory and approved owners
positive_evidence: Review approved centrally managed script inventory and ownership against policy links and change records.
negative_control: Approved software deployment or logon maintenance.
limitations: Inventory cannot establish script execution or integrity on every endpoint.

title: GPO audit completeness
detection_hypothesis: Review directory and SYSVOL collection coverage
positive_evidence: Reconcile directory and SYSVOL audit coverage with collector health and approved retention requirements.
negative_control: Approved maintenance or forwarding exclusions.
limitations: One source cannot establish complete policy-change visibility.

title: RDP logon visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review remote interactive session and approved access inventory
positive_evidence: Review destination session logs and approved remote-access records for the scoped account and host.
negative_control: Help-desk or administrator RDP sessions.
limitations: A successful remote session alone does not prove lateral movement.

title: SMB share access visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review share access and administrative context
positive_evidence: Review share-access records with the destination, identity, share purpose and approved administrative activity.
negative_control: File access, backups and centrally managed software distribution.
limitations: Ordinary SMB share activity is not necessarily remote administration or adversary movement.

title: WinRM session visibility
detection_hypothesis: Correlate remote management operational logs and endpoint context
positive_evidence: Corroborate authentication records with independently supplied WinRM operational or management records.
negative_control: Approved remote management and configuration automation.
limitations: A generic network logon event does not establish use of WinRM.

title: WMI remote management visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review WMI operational evidence and authorized administration
positive_evidence: Correlate endpoint and management records that identify the approved WMI operation and its owner.
negative_control: Inventory, monitoring and enterprise management software.
limitations: Process creation alone does not establish WMI use or remote origin.

title: Remote service installation visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review service installation records with software deployment approvals
positive_evidence: Review service installation records with endpoint management history and the authorized change ticket.
negative_control: Software deployment, monitoring agent installation or updates.
limitations: Installation evidence does not establish execution or remote origin.

title: Remote scheduled task visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review task creation records with remote session context
positive_evidence: Review scheduled task creation with the task owner, approved maintenance record and supplied runtime evidence if relevant.
negative_control: Scheduled maintenance and centrally managed tasks.
limitations: Creation alone does not establish task execution or remote origin.

title: Explicit credential logon visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review explicit credential usage and authorized administration
positive_evidence: Review explicit-credential logon record with process, session and approved administration context where available.
negative_control: Approved run-as or scheduled administrative operation.
limitations: 4648 records an attempt with explicit credentials, not proof of successful remote logon.

title: Privileged network logon
detection_hypothesis: Review linked logon and privilege events against administrative baseline
positive_evidence: Correlate destination logon and special-privilege records in the same host/session context against management inventory.
negative_control: Approved remote administration or service activity.
limitations: Privilege assignment does not establish a privileged operation or malicious movement.

title: Remote management source review
detection_hypothesis: Review source host identity against approved management systems
positive_evidence: Reconcile destination logon source with approved management inventory and time-valid network context.
negative_control: Approved support host or remote access gateway.
limitations: Source fields and gateway addresses may not uniquely identify the originating device.

title: Domain workstation session anomaly
detection_hypothesis: Review user/device deviations with identity context
positive_evidence: Correlate the scoped session with account ownership, expected workstation use and incident context.
negative_control: Travel, workstation replacement or approved support activity.
limitations: An anomalous session is not proof of compromised domain credentials.

title: Lateral movement correlation completeness
detection_hypothesis: Review endpoint, destination and DC source availability
positive_evidence: Review whether endpoint, identity and network records share sufficient scope and time context.
negative_control: Known collector outage or approved source migration.
limitations: Missing telemetry is a coverage limitation, not proof of prevention.

title: Administrative share governance
detection_hypothesis: Review approved remote administration and share access policy
positive_evidence: Compare approved administrative share access policy and role inventory with documented support requirements.
negative_control: Approved management and deployment services.
limitations: Share policy is not evidence of actual access or file transfer.

title: Domain account creation
detection_hypothesis: Review new identity against onboarding approval
positive_evidence: Compare the account creation record with the identity provisioning request, creator and owner.
negative_control: Approved onboarding and application-account provisioning.
limitations: Account creation does not establish unauthorized persistence.

title: Domain account deletion
detection_hypothesis: Review identity removal against offboarding records
positive_evidence: Reconcile account deletion with stable account identity and approved offboarding ticket.
negative_control: Normal employee offboarding or cleanup.
limitations: Deletion does not prove revocation of all sessions or external access.

title: Disabled account enablement
detection_hypothesis: Review enablement against identity lifecycle approvals
positive_evidence: Review account enablement actor and target with approved reactivation and owner record.
negative_control: Approved returning employee or service recovery.
limitations: Enablement does not establish a subsequent sign-in.

title: Domain account disablement
detection_hypothesis: Review disablement against approved lifecycle activity
positive_evidence: Review disabled-account event with approved lifecycle action and owner confirmation.
negative_control: Ordinary offboarding or temporary suspension.
limitations: Disablement alone does not prove all existing sessions ended immediately.

title: Password reset visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review reset events with helpdesk and account owner records
positive_evidence: Review reset-attempt outcome, target account and helpdesk authorization.
negative_control: Approved account recovery or service maintenance.
limitations: 4724 can represent success or failure; reset attempt is not proof of account compromise.

title: Account lockout visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review lockout records with authentication context
positive_evidence: Review lockout record with scoped authentication timeline and support context.
negative_control: Stale saved credentials or ordinary password errors.
limitations: Lockout alone does not establish hostile intent or the originating endpoint.

title: Privileged group member addition
detection_hypothesis: Review membership additions against access approvals
positive_evidence: Compare membership change evidence and resulting membership snapshot with the privileged access request.
negative_control: Approved just-in-time administration or role assignment.
limitations: A group addition does not establish attacker control; assess effective permissions separately.

title: Privileged group member removal
detection_hypothesis: Review membership removals against approved changes
positive_evidence: Compare group membership removal record and approved role-change ticket using stable group and member identity.
negative_control: Approved offboarding or access recertification.
limitations: Removal does not establish loss of all effective access through other memberships.

title: Account setting modification
detection_hypothesis: Review user account changes against baseline and approval
positive_evidence: Compare user account modification and relevant before/after attributes against approved lifecycle change.
negative_control: Approved profile or policy maintenance.
limitations: A generic account change does not prove a security-sensitive setting changed.

title: Domain password policy review
detection_hypothesis: Review effective password policy against organizational requirements
positive_evidence: Review effective password policy and applicable fine-grained policy inventory with approved identity governance.
negative_control: Documented policy exceptions for managed identities.
limitations: A policy review is not proof of password strength or runtime enforcement.

title: Trust creation visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review new trusted domain relationship against approval
positive_evidence: Compare the new trust record with approved architecture, counterpart ownership and change record.
negative_control: Approved merger, migration or integration.
limitations: Trust existence does not demonstrate adversarial use.

title: Trust removal visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review removed trust relationship against change record
positive_evidence: Review the removed trust and approved decommission plan with dependent service owners.
negative_control: Planned domain separation or retirement.
limitations: Removal is a related trust change, not necessarily adversarial trust manipulation.

title: Trust modification visibility
detection_hypothesis: Review trust configuration changes against authorized baseline
positive_evidence: Compare documented before/after trust configuration and approval with the scoped change record.
negative_control: Approved changes during migration or maintenance.
limitations: Configuration drift alone does not establish misuse.

title: Trust direction review
detection_hypothesis: Review trust relationships against business ownership
positive_evidence: Compare trust direction and business owners with approved cross-domain access design.
negative_control: Approved organizational integration or migration.
limitations: Trust direction alone does not establish effective cross-domain authorization.

title: Trust transitivity review
detection_hypothesis: Review transitive relationships against architecture requirements
positive_evidence: Review transitivity settings against approved forest/domain architecture and documented exceptions.
negative_control: Approved multi-domain design.
limitations: Configuration alone does not establish reachable resources or actual authentication.

title: Trust SID filtering posture
detection_hypothesis: Review trust protections against approved security policy
positive_evidence: Review approved trust configuration snapshots and security architecture decisions with domain owners.
negative_control: Approved migration exception with documented expiry.
limitations: Settings alone do not establish cross-domain compromise.

title: Selective authentication posture
detection_hypothesis: Review trust authentication controls against approved access design
positive_evidence: Review effective selective-authentication posture against approved cross-domain access requirements.
negative_control: Approved trust migration exception.
limitations: Configuration alone does not establish actual enforcement or resource access.

title: Cross-domain authentication anomaly
detection_hypothesis: Review identity and destination domain context against authorized flows
positive_evidence: Correlate source and destination domain identities in scoped authentication records against approved trust flows.
negative_control: Approved cross-domain resource access.
limitations: Authentication records alone do not establish unauthorized cross-domain movement.

title: Trust inventory completeness
detection_hypothesis: Review inventory coverage across in-scope domains and forests
positive_evidence: Reconcile trust inventory across authorized domain owners and identify inaccessible or stale sources.
negative_control: Approved retired domain or temporary inventory outage.
limitations: Partial inventory cannot establish that no additional trusts exist.

title: Additional directory credentials review
detection_hypothesis: Review identity credential-related changes against approved provisioning
positive_evidence: Review independently supplied directory attribute change records with credential governance and identity ownership.
negative_control: Approved credential enrollment or rotation.
limitations: A generic directory change is not proof of unauthorized credential addition.

title: SID history change
detection_hypothesis: Review migration-related identity changes with approved migration records
positive_evidence: Review SID-history change records alongside migration approval and independently supplied identity evidence.
negative_control: Approved domain migration.
limitations: A change alone does not establish unauthorized token manipulation or use.

title: Privileged group persistence review
detection_hypothesis: Review persistent privileged access against periodic access review
positive_evidence: Review privileged group changes, access approvals, expiry and resulting membership.
negative_control: Approved temporary or permanent role assignment.
limitations: Membership change alone cannot demonstrate persistence or actor intent.

title: Protected identity permission drift
detection_hypothesis: Review protected identity permissions against approved baseline
positive_evidence: Compare protected identity effective permissions with dated approved baseline and owner review.
negative_control: Approved privileged access recertification.
limitations: Permission drift does not prove persistence or actual access.

title: Domain audit policy change
detection_hypothesis: Review changes to audit policy against approved maintenance
positive_evidence: Compare audit policy snapshots and the authorized change record; assess whether logging was actually reduced.
negative_control: Approved audit-policy tuning and maintenance.
limitations: A policy change event alone does not establish impaired logging.

title: Security log clear event
detection_hypothesis: Review log clear evidence with administrator and retention records
positive_evidence: Review the log-clear event with the responsible administrator, retention record and approved maintenance history.
negative_control: Authorized log maintenance or lab reset.
limitations: The event establishes a reported clear action, not necessarily malicious intent.

title: Directory object restoration
detection_hypothesis: Review restored object against recovery change records
positive_evidence: Review directory object undelete record with stable object identity and recovery ticket.
negative_control: Approved accidental-deletion recovery.
limitations: Restoration does not establish that all prior permissions or services were restored.

title: Directory object move
detection_hypothesis: Review moved object and policy scope impact against approval
positive_evidence: Compare object-move record and before/after location with approved change and policy-scope review.
negative_control: Approved OU restructuring.
limitations: An object move does not independently prove a resulting policy change or malicious persistence.

title: Sensitive identity lifecycle drift
detection_hypothesis: Review dormant, orphaned and unexpected privileged identities
positive_evidence: Reconcile dormant and orphaned privileged identities with owner, employment/service status and approved exceptions.
negative_control: Approved emergency or rarely used service account.
limitations: Inactivity and missing ownership records alone do not establish compromise.

title: Defensive sensor coverage review
detection_hypothesis: Review endpoint and DC sensor health, coverage and retention
positive_evidence: Compare expected endpoint sensors with the approved asset inventory, source heartbeat and retention status.
negative_control: Documented maintenance or approved decommission.
limitations: Healthy heartbeat alone does not establish coverage for every security behavior.
